caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic spur with a U-shaped body and a rowel at one end. The spur has two rectangular slots on each arm, likely for attaching straps, and is colored with shades of brown, green, and hints of ochre, indicating a patinated metallic surface. The rowel is circular and spiked, attached to the end of the spur by a short extension. The object is centered within a lightly outlined rectangular frame, with the label "actual size" written at the bottom. In the upper left corner, there is a smaller, monochrome line drawing of the same spur, showing a top-down view with the dimensions written below. The drawing is signed "A. Walbeck" at the bottom right. The background is a neutral, cream color.
title: Spur
